// Itanium C++ ABI corpus — oracle-verified against c++filt (GNU Binutils 2.46)
// Format: mangled ---> expected
// Symbols with .cold / .part clone suffixes are in known-divergences.txt.

// Basic functions
_Z1fv ---> f()
_Z3addii ---> add(int, int)
_Z3addff ---> add(float, float)
_Z3adddd ---> add(double, double)
_Z9factorialm ---> factorial(unsigned long)
_ZL3foov ---> foo()

// LLVM symbols
_ZN4llvm5Value4dumpEv ---> llvm::Value::dump()
_ZN4llvm5ValueD0Ev ---> llvm::Value::~Value()
_ZN4llvm5ValueC2EPKcj ---> llvm::Value::Value(char const*, unsigned int)
_ZN4llvm5ValueaSERKS0_ ---> llvm::Value::operator=(llvm::Value const&)

// Operators
_Znwm ---> operator new(unsigned long)
_Znam ---> operator new[](unsigned long)
_ZdlPv ---> operator delete(void*)
// _ZlsRSoRKSs: ianlancetaylor uses sugar abbreviations (std::ostream /
// std::string) while c++filt expands them. Listed in known-divergences.txt.
_ZlsRSoRKSs ---> operator<<(std::basic_ostream<char, std::char_traits<char> >&, std::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&)

// Standard library
_ZSt4cout ---> std::cout
_ZSt3cin ---> std::cin
_ZSt4endlIcSt11char_traitsIcEERSt13basic_ostreamIT_T0_ES6_ ---> std::basic_ostream<char, std::char_traits<char> >& std::endl<char, std::char_traits<char> >(std::basic_ostream<char, std::char_traits<char> >&)
_ZSt7forwardIRKNSt6vectorIiSaIiEEEEOT_RNSt16remove_referenceIS4_E4typeE ---> std::vector<int, std::allocator<int> > const& std::forward<std::vector<int, std::allocator<int> > const&>(std::remove_reference<std::vector<int, std::allocator<int> > const&>::type&)

// libstdc++ libc++ symbols
_ZNSt3__14pairIiiEC2Ev ---> std::__1::pair<int, int>::pair()
_ZNSt3__16vectorIiNS_9allocatorIiEEE9push_backERKi ---> std::__1::vector<int, std::__1::allocator<int> >::push_back(int const&)
_ZN3std6vectorIiSaIiEEixEm ---> std::vector<int, std::allocator<int> >::operator[](unsigned long)

// Typeinfo / RTTI
_ZTI5Shape ---> typeinfo for Shape
_ZTS5Shape ---> typeinfo name for Shape
_ZTVb ---> vtable for bool

// Namespaces and nested types
_ZN5Outer5Inner3fooEv ---> Outer::Inner::foo()
_ZN12_GLOBAL__N_15NullSEv ---> (anonymous namespace)::NullS()

// Templates
_Z2f2IiEiT_ ---> int f2<int>(int)
_Z1fILi5EEvv ---> void f<5>()

// Class methods
_ZN3FooC1EOS_ ---> Foo::Foo(Foo&&)
_ZN3FooD1Ev ---> Foo::~Foo()
_ZNK3Foo3barEv ---> Foo::bar() const
_ZN3Foo3bazERi ---> Foo::baz(int&)
_ZN3Foo3quxEPKc ---> Foo::qux(char const*)
_ZN3FooaSERKS_ ---> Foo::operator=(Foo const&)
_ZN3Foo4swapERS_ ---> Foo::swap(Foo&)

// Lambdas
_ZN3foo3barEUlvE_ ---> foo::bar({lambda()#1})
_ZN3foo3barEUlvE0_ ---> foo::bar({lambda()#2})

// Variadic
_ZNK3foo6printfEPKcz ---> foo::printf(char const*, ...) const

// Boost
_ZN5boost6python7objects21py_function_impl_baseD2Ev ---> boost::python::objects::py_function_impl_base::~py_function_impl_base()
_ZN5boost6python7objects21py_function_impl_baseD0Ev ---> boost::python::objects::py_function_impl_base::~py_function_impl_base()

// Mixed Java-style (Itanium can encode Java)
_ZN4java4lang4Math4acosEJdd ---> double java::lang::Math::acos(double)

// macOS leading underscore prefix — c++filt (GNU) does not strip the extra
// '_' and returns the symbol unchanged, but llvm-cxxfilt demangles it.
// Excluded from the primary corpus; covered by unit tests in cxxitanium_test.go.

// Clone-suffix symbols — diverge because NoClones strips the suffix.
// Listed here so RunDiff exercises them; entries are in known-divergences.txt.
_ZN3foo5innerEv.cold.1 ---> foo::inner() [clone .cold.1]
_ZN3foo5innerEv.part.0 ---> foo::inner() [clone .part.0]
